tweets.text: Introducing Muse Spark 1.3 — our new open multimodal model. 8B params, Apache 2.0, now available for download. Blog: https://ai.meta.com/blog/muse-spark
Muse Voice Transcribe is now live for all developers. 30x realtime, 99.1% accuracy on the WildArtifactBench. Try it: https://ai.meta.com/voice
WildArtifactBench results are in — 12.4% improvement over the previous SOTA on multimodal artifact detection.
RT @AIatMeta: We are hiring research engineers in Menlo Park. Come build with us!
